arxiv-2101-10315.title: 2 2 -generated axial algebras of Monster type
arxiv-2101-10315.creator: Clara Franchi, Mario Mainardis, Sergey Shpectorov
arxiv-2101-10315.description: Abstract . We provide the basic setup for the project, initiated by Felix Rehren in [ 20 ] , aiming at classifying all 2 2 -generated axial algebras of Monster type ( α , β ) (\alpha,\beta) over a field 𝔽 {\mathbb{F}} .

arxiv-2104-09965.title: Avoiding squares over words with lists of size three amongst four symbols
arxiv-2104-09965.creator: Matthieu Rosenfeld
arxiv-2104-09965.description: Abstract In 2007, Grytczuk conjecture that for any sequence ( ℓ i ) i ≥ 1 (\ell_{i})_{i\geq 1} of alphabets of size 3 3 there exists a square-free infinite word w w such that for all i i , the i i -th letter of w w belongs to ℓ i \ell_{i} .

arxiv-2112-15147.title: An Automatically Verified Prototype of a Landing Gear System
arxiv-2112-15147.creator: Maximiliano Cristiá, Gianfranco Rossi
arxiv-2112-15147.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Maximiliano Cristiá, Gianfranco Rossi. In this paper we show how { log } \{log\} (read ‘setlog’), a Constraint Logic Programming (CLP) language based on set theory, can be used as an automated verifier for B specifications. In particular we encode in { log } \{log\} an Event-B specification, developed by Mammar and Laleau, of the case study known as the Landing Gear System (LGS).

arxiv-2312-11642.title: The Challenge of Measuring Asteroid Masses with Gaia DR2 astrometry Journal: PSJ
arxiv-2312-11642.creator: Zachary Murray
arxiv-2312-11642.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zachary Murray. The Gaia second data release contains high-accuracy astrometric measurements of thousands of solar system bodies. These measurements raise the possibility of determining asteroid masses by modeling scattering events between massive objects observed by Gaia. In this paper, we identify promising encounters between small asteroids that occur during the second data release and quantify the various errors involved in mass determination.

arxiv-2402-12302.title: Asymptotic Gaussian Fluctuations of Eigenvectors in Spectral Clustering
arxiv-2402-12302.creator: Hugo Lebeau, Florent Chatelain, Romain Couillet
arxiv-2402-12302.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hugo Lebeau, Florent Chatelain, Romain Couillet. The performance of spectral clustering relies on the fluctuations of the entries of the eigenvectors of a similarity matrix, which has been left uncharacterized until now. In this letter, it is shown that the signal + + noise structure of a general spike random matrix model is transferred to the eigenvectors of the corresponding Gram kernel matrix and the fluctuations of their entries are Gaussian in the large-dimensional regime.

arxiv-2410-03693.title: Linear Independence of Generalized Neurons and Related Functions
arxiv-2410-03693.creator: Leyang Zhang
arxiv-2410-03693.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Leyang Zhang. The linear independence of neurons plays a significant role in theoretical analysis of neural networks. Specifically, given neurons H 1 , … , H n : ℝ N × ℝ d → ℝ H_{1},...,H_{n}:\mathbb{R}^{N}\times\mathbb{R}^{d}\to\mathbb{R} , we are interested in the following question: when are { H 1 ​ ( θ 1 , ⋅ ) , … , H n ​ ( θ n , ⋅ ) } \{H_{1}(\theta_{1},\cdot),...,H_{n}(\theta_{n},\cdot)\} are linearly independent as the parameters θ 1 , … , θ n \theta_{1},...,\theta_{n}

arxiv-2410-07536.title: I-Max: Maximize the Resolution Potential of Pre-trained Rectified Flow Transformers with Projected Flow
arxiv-2410-07536.creator: Ruoyi Du, Dongyang Liu, Le Zhuo, Qi Qin, Hongsheng Li, Zhanyu Ma, Peng Gao
arxiv-2410-07536.description: Abstract Rectified Flow Transformers (RFTs) offer superior training and inference efficiency, making them likely the most viable direction for scaling up diffusion models. However, progress in generation resolution has been relatively slow due to data quality and training costs. Tuning-free resolution extrapolation presents an alternative, but current methods often reduce generative stability, limiting practical application.

arxiv-2501-08347.title: SCOT: Self-Supervised Contrastive Pretraining For Zero-Shot Compositional Retrieval
arxiv-2501-08347.creator: Bhavin Jawade, João V. B. Soares, Kapil Thadani, Deen Dayal Mohan, Amir Erfan Eshratifar, Benjamin Culpepper, Paloma de Juan, Srirangaraj Setlur, Venu Govindaraju
arxiv-2501-08347.description: Abstract Compositional image retrieval (CIR) is a multimodal learning task where a model combines a query image with a user-provided text modification to retrieve a target image. CIR finds applications in a variety of domains including product retrieval (e-commerce) and web search.

arxiv-2506-13919.title: Rotational Variables: Kepler Versus ASAS-SN ⋆ Corresponding author: stethem.5@buckeyemail.osu.edu
arxiv-2506-13919.creator: Jack Stethem 1 , ⋆ {}^{1,\,\star}, Christopher S. Kochanek 1,2, Anya Phillips 3, Lyra Cao 4, and Marc Pinsonneault 1
arxiv-2506-13919.description: Abstract Rotational variables are stars that vary in brightness due to star spots modulated by rotation. They are probes of stellar magnetism, binarity, and evolution. [ 42 ] explored distinct populations of ∼ \sim 50,000 high–amplitude rotational variables from the All-Sky Automated Survey for Supernovae (ASAS-SN), examining correlations between stellar rotation, binarity, and activity.

arxiv-2509-17602.title: Notebook for the LifeCLEF Lab at CLEF 2025
arxiv-2509-17602.creator: Giulio Martellucci, Hervé Goëau, Pierre Bonnet, Fabrice Vinatier, Alexis Joly
arxiv-2509-17602.description: Abstract Quadrat images are essential for ecological studies, as they enable standardized sampling, the assessment of plant biodiversity, long-term monitoring, and large-scale field campaigns. These images typically cover an area of fifty centimetres or one square meter, and botanists carefully identify all the species present.

arxiv-2512-11613.title: Boltzmann to Lindblad: Classical and Quantum Approaches to Out-of-Equilibrium Statistical Mechanics Journal: \JSTAT
arxiv-2512-11613.creator: Ralf Blossey
arxiv-2512-11613.description: Abstract Open quantum systems play a central role in contemporary nanoscale technologies, including molecular electronics, quantum heat engines, quantum computation and information processing. A major theoretical challenge is to construct dynamical models that are simultaneously consistent with classical thermodynamics and with the requirement of complete positivity of quantum evolution.

europmc-pmc5540680.title: The Lifespan and Turnover of Microglia in the Human Brain.
europmc-pmc5540680.creator: Réu P, Khosravi A, Bernard S, Mold JE, Salehpour M, Alkass K, Perl S, Tisdale J, Possnert G, Druid H, Frisén J.
europmc-pmc5540680.description: The hematopoietic system seeds the CNS with microglial progenitor cells during the fetal period, but the subsequent cell generation dynamics and maintenance of this population have been poorly understood. We report that microglia, unlike most other hematopoietic lineages, renew...

pmc-10660097.title: Development of a nano-size off-grid energy system using renewables and IoT technologies at the Meteoria visitor center: A Finnish case study
pmc-10660097.creator: Jessica Tuuf, Hans Lindén, Sami Lieskoski, Margareta Björklund-Sänkiaho
pmc-10660097.description: The increased utilization of non-renewable energy during the last century has influenced the climate, with increased carbon dioxide emissions and elevated temperature as a result. Thus, the need to develop and demonstrate new sustainable solutions regarding both energy supply and consumption, but also energy system optimization, is obvious.

pmc-10707534.title: Numerical Simulation of an Inverted Perovskite Solar Cell Using a SiOx Layer as Down-Conversion Energy Material to Improve Efficiency and Stability
pmc-10707534.creator: Ezequiel Paz Totolhua, Jesús Carrillo López, Alfredo Benítez Lara, Karim Monfil Leyva, Ana C. Piñón Reyes, Javier Flores-Méndez, José Alberto Luna López
pmc-10707534.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Inverted perovskite solar cells (PSCs) have gained much attention due to their low hysteresis effect, easy fabrication, and good stability. In this research, an inverted perovskite solar cell ITO/PEDOT:PSS/CH3NH3PbI3/PCBM/Ag structure was simulated and optimized using SCAPS-1D version 3.3.10 software. The influence on the device of parameters, including perovskite thickness, total defect density, series and shunt resistances, and operating temperature, are discussed and analyzed. With optimized parameters, the efficiency increased from 13.47% to 18.33%.

pmc-10743523.title: Wound Microbiota and Its Impact on Wound Healing
pmc-10743523.creator: Małgorzata Zielińska, Agnieszka Pawłowska, Anna Orzeł, Luiza Sulej, Katarzyna Muzyka-Placzyńska, Arkadiusz Baran, Dagmara Filipecka-Tyczka, Paulina Pawłowska, Aleksandra Nowińska, Joanna Bogusławska, Anna Scholz, Elia Ranzato
pmc-10743523.description: Wound healing is a complex process influenced by age, systemic conditions, and local factors. The wound microbiota’s crucial role in this process is gaining recognition. This concise review outlines wound microbiota impacts on healing, emphasizing distinct phases like hemostasis, inflammation, and cell proliferation. Inflammatory responses, orchestrated by growth factors and cytokines, recruit neutrophils and monocytes to eliminate pathogens and debris.

pmc-10754545.title: Effect of psychological care on the prenatal mental state and vaginal delivery in pregnant women during the early stages of the COVID-19 epidemic
pmc-10754545.creator: Yanping Liu, Xinai Xu
pmc-10754545.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The COVID-19 pandemic has had a profound impact on the lives of people globally, including pregnant women. We aimed to explore the influence of a psychological care intervention based on behavioral change theory on the prenatal mental state and mode of delivery in pregnant women from June 2020 to June 2022 during the early stage of the COVID-19 epidemic in China.

pmc-11380790.title: Genome-wide identification of cannabinoid biosynthesis genes in non-drug type Cannabis (Cannabis sativa L.) cultivar
pmc-11380790.creator: Benny Jian Rong Sng, Yu Jeong Jeong, Sing Hui Leong, Jae Cheol Jeong, Jiyoung Lee, Sarojam Rajani, Cha Young Kim, In-Cheol Jang
pmc-11380790.description: BackgroundCannabis sativa cultivars can be classified as marijuana or hemp, depending on its amount of the psychoactive cannabinoid Δ9‐tetrahydrocannabinolic acid (THCA). Hemp Cheungsam is a non-drug type Cannabis sativa that is characterized by low THCA content. However, the transcripts and expression profile of cannabinoid biosynthesis pathway genes of hemp Cheungsam have not been investigated.

pmc-11489204.title: Efficacy and safety of tocilizumab in Chinese patients with systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis: a multicentre phase IV trial
pmc-11489204.creator: Caifeng Li, Xuemei Tang, Zhixuan Zhou, Li Sun, Meiping Lu, Wei Zhou, Sirui Yang, Wenjie Zheng, Haiguo Yu, Weiping Tan, Junmei Zhang, Yu Zhang, Yuxiu Kong, Jiahui Xu
pmc-11489204.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectivesGiven the limited tocilizumab (TCZ) treatment data for systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis (sJIA) in China, we evaluated the long-term efficacy and safety of TCZ in Chinese patients with sJIA.MethodIn this multicentre, interventional Phase IV study, patients with sJIA and inadequate clinical response to non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs/corticosteroids received TCZ infusions every 2 weeks based on body weight (< 30 kg, 12 mg/kg; ≥ 30 kg, 8 mg/kg), over a 52-week open-label period and an 8-week safety follow-up period.

pmc-11502970.title: Understanding Pediatric Experiences With Symptomatic Varicoceles: Mixed Methods Study of an Online Varicocele Community
pmc-11502970.creator: Grace E Sollender, Tommy Jiang, Ilana Finkelshtein, Vadim Osadchiy, Michael H Zheng, Jesse N Mills, Jennifer S Singer, Sriram V Eleswarapu, Amaryllis Mavragani, Kristina Suson, Mahmoud Elbattah, Philip Wong, Daniel Pucheril
pmc-11502970.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundVaricoceles affect up to 30% of postpubertal adolescent males. Studying this population remains difficult due to this topic’s sensitive nature. Using the popularity of social media in this cohort and natural language processing (NLP) techniques, our aim was to identify perceptions of adolescent males on an internet varicocele forum to inform how physicians may better evaluate and counsel this pediatric population.ObjectiveWe aimed to characterize themes of discussion and specific concerns expressed by adolescents using a mixed methods approach involving quantitative NLP and

pmc-12711452.title: Cognitive processing therapy for posttraumatic stress disorder in first responders and veterans: Flexing the approach with explicit case formulation
pmc-12711452.creator: Reginald D. V. Nixon, David Forbes, Tara E. Galovski
pmc-12711452.description: There is a need to improve psychological interventions for first responders and veterans with posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD). We conducted an open trial integrating explicit case formulation (CF) within cognitive processing therapy (CPT) in a sample primarily composed of first responders (N = 29).

pmc-12719526.title: Molecular mechanisms and therapeutic strategies of cGAS-STING pathway in liver disease: the quest continues
pmc-12719526.creator: Yichen Fan, Zihao Dong, Yufeng Wu, Hao Wen
pmc-12719526.description: The cyclic GMP-AMP synthase–stimulator of interferon genes (cGAS-STING) pathway has emerged as a central regulator of liver homeostasis and pathology, governing innate immunity, inflammation, fibrogenesis, and tissue repair. Dysregulated cGAS-STING signaling, often driven by cytosolic DNA sensing, cellular stress, or cross-activation with other immune pathways, leads to excessive type I interferons and pro-inflammatory cytokine production, exacerbating liver injury.

pmc-12978918.title: Global Research Trends and Hotspots in Gene Editing and Stem Cell Therapies for Neurodegenerative Diseases: Bibliometric and Visualization Analysis
pmc-12978918.creator: Lijun Xiang, Yun Xiao, Ming Cai, Jing Qin, Ting Wang, Xueming Xiang, Jun Ke, Ganlin Peng, Amy Schwartz, Matthew Balcarras
pmc-12978918.description: BackgroundNeurodegenerative diseases are a major and growing global health burden. Their pathogenesis is complex, and effective therapies remain limited. Gene editing and stem cell–based strategies are reshaping the therapeutic landscape. However, the field has not been systematically examined through bibliometric analysis.

pmc-13155446.title: The Effect of Transcranial Near-infrared Laser Therapy on Chronic Ischemic Stroke Patients: A Randomized, Single-blind, Sham-controlled Trial
pmc-13155446.creator: Merna Hassan, Osama Al Balah, Ahmed Hegazy, El Sayed Satour
pmc-13155446.description: BackgroundTranscranial photobiomodulation (TPBM) using near-infrared (NIR) light is a novel, non-invasive neuromodulation strategy with potential to enhance neurorecovery. While preclinical studies are promising, clinical evidence in chronic stroke remains limited and inconsistent.ObjectiveTo evaluate the efficacy and safety of 980 nm transcranial NIR laser therapy as an adjunct to standard rehabilitation in improving neurological function in patients with chronic ischemic stroke.

pmc-13434350.title: Catchment lithology controls net carbon balance along the Antarctic Peninsula
pmc-13434350.creator: Songfan He, Xiaowen Zhang, Huanting Hu, Maojun Yan, Huiyuan Yang, Qiyue Gu, Thomas S. Bianchi, Xiaomei Xu, Xingqian Cui

pmc-13500299.title: Reinforcement learning personalized instruction for psychological engagement self-regulated learning motivation and performance in professional English education
pmc-13500299.creator: Li Peiyao
pmc-13500299.description: Adaptive educational technologies are increasingly used to personalize learning pathways. However, limited evidence has examined whether reinforcement learning (RL)-personalized instruction is associated with psychologically meaningful learning outcomes in Professional English education. This study compared an RL-personalized instructional pathway with a fixed-path control pathway among 200 learners across an 8-week, 16-session Professional English program.
